blurb: Guests rent snowmobiles and side by side (RZR) vehicles to ride unguided on 130 miles of scenic roads and groomed trails in the Arapahoe National Forest. The location is 3 miles northwest of Grand Lake, Colorado, right on the Stillwater OHV Trail System. Rentals include access to varied trails with scenic views and forest landscapes.
